name: zsnd_group_queue_stream_request
description: zSndGroup::QueueStreamRequest initializes stream manager state, enforces play-solo, reuses or allocates a stream request, captures optional 3D state, queues the request active, and begins the group.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage avoids a full streaming backend and focuses on the caller-visible request contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x4a5250 validates lazy manager init, play-solo active-request search, free-list reuse, malloc fallback, zero-initialization, active-list push, gain/group/handle-kind/state fields, optional world-position and velocity capture, and StateBeginGroup return gate.

The native smokes verify reused and malloc-created requests, active/free-list transitions, world-position and velocity capture, no-position simple requests, play-solo rejection, selected entry assignment, and lazy manager initialization.
